pass1516_radical_graded_relations.headline: The quadratic multiplication kernels have dimensions 29 at p=2 and 70 at p=3. Characteristic 3 has the substantially denser relation ideal already in degree two.

p2.boundary: These are relation spaces in the radical-associated graded algebra. They do not by themselves separate minimal higher-degree generators from consequences of lower-degree relations, and they do not yet give the complete Ext^2/Yoneda multiplication table.
p2.interpretation: For S=A/J and B=J/J^2, the canonical tensor-algebra map T_S(B) -> gr_J(A) is surjective. The listed kernel dimensions are therefore exact homogeneous relation-space dimensions.

p3.interpretation: For S=A/J and B=J/J^2, the canonical tensor-algebra map T_S(B) -> gr_J(A) is surjective. The listed kernel dimensions are therefore exact homogeneous relation-space dimensions.

pass1516_radical_graded_relations.theorem: Exact tensor-algebra relation defects in characteristics 2 and 3

pass1517_coordinate_free_fourier.boundary: The frozen U and U^{-1} hashes certify one deterministic trivialization, not an invariant under arbitrary changes of models for the irreducibles.
pass1517_coordinate_free_fourier.coordinate_free_content: The fourteen central isotypic summands and the evaluation isomorphism are canonical. A Fourier matrix is only a choice of bases in the two factors of each summand.
pass1517_coordinate_free_fourier.theorem: Basis-free double-centralizer form of the selector Fourier decomposition

pass1518_apartment_d4_obstruction.boundary: The cardinality argument proves nonexistence of a global rank-preserving lift. It does not compute the full rectangle-by-rectangle S3 residual cocycle.
pass1518_apartment_d4_obstruction.correct_symmetry_object: Local D4 transport must be chart-dependent (an action groupoid with a residual-label cocycle), or it must leave the frozen 24-sheet family.
pass1518_apartment_d4_obstruction.proof: Every orbit of any D4-action on the 24 sheets that projects to the standard action on masks must project onto a four-element mask orbit, so each invariant rank level must have cardinality divisible by four. The unique rank-76 sheet violates this necessary condition.
pass1518_apartment_d4_obstruction.theorem: Cardinality obstruction to a global rank-preserving D4 lift

pass1519_maximal_order_arithmetic.boundary: The index and discriminant determine prime support and total local lengths, but not the blockwise conductor exponents, Bass/Eichler status, or the Smith invariants of M_O/O. Those require the frozen transition matrix itself.
pass1519_maximal_order_arithmetic.componentwise_reason: Each labeled block M_n(Z) is Morita equivalent to Z, whose ideal class group is trivial.
pass1519_maximal_order_arithmetic.theorem: Prime support, conductor bound, and componentwise class triviality

pass1520_equivariant_morita.G_action: g.x = rho_V(g) x rho_W(g)^(-1), and similarly on Y
pass1520_equivariant_morita.boundary: This does not make any individual apartment bridge G-invariant, nor does it supply a preferred G-fixed identification between V and W (their dimensions differ).
pass1520_equivariant_morita.fixed_cross_map_interpretation: Hom_G(W,V)=0 forbids a G-fixed bridge element. It does not forbid the full Hom(W,V) space from being a G-equivariant equivalence bimodule.
pass1520_equivariant_morita.theorem: The saturated full-matrix Morita context is G-equivariant; the fixed-bridge obstruction is not a Morita obstruction
pass1520_equivariant_morita.upgrade: Pass 1504's 75 gauge bridges are a generating frame, not an invariant bimodule. Their corner saturation is the full Hom(W,V), which is canonically G-stable and supplies the equivariant Morita equivalence.
